purpose: Measure whether disposable ChatGPT Instant invocations operating from durable Workspace Control state can match long-horizon frontier reasoning on decomposable research/evaluate/iterate work, and identify the residual boundary where stronger reasoning is required.

hypotheses.H1_horizon_equivalence: When every bounded reasoning node is within Instant capability, stateless durable resumptions can match a stronger long-lived reasoning session on final validated outcome.
hypotheses.H2_decomposition_recovery: Tasks that fail as one large Instant request may become solvable when decomposed into independently verifiable leaves plus bounded synthesis/critique.
hypotheses.H3_intrinsic_difficulty: Repeated continuation does not reliably compensate for a remaining node whose reasoning requirements exceed Instant capability.
hypotheses.H4_state_externalization: Durable semantic state plus bounded context packets can reduce conversation-context dependence without reducing outcome quality.
hypotheses.H5_async_efficiency: External waits can be handled without reasoning-model polling when CI/experiment completion is represented as an event that makes the reasoning process READY_TO_RESUME.

reasoning_process_state.authority_rule: ReasoningProcess state and CandidateAction objects carry no execution authority. Authority must be referenced from existing authority-owned policy/task state.
reasoning_process_state.checkpoint_rule: Every invocation must persist all new durable findings/evidence refs/open questions/next action before yielding. No essential continuation state may exist only in chat prose.
reasoning_process_state.context_rule: A resumed worker receives a pointer plus bounded state/evidence references, not the prior conversation transcript by default.

A_frontier_long_horizon.description: One strong/frontier reasoning session handles the objective and all result interpretation within ordinary tool/session limits.

B_instant_persistent_chat.description: One Instant conversation is repeatedly told to continue after bounded yields; durable state is still required.

C_instant_stateless_resume.description: Each reasoning quantum starts in a fresh Instant chat from only durable state + bounded context packet.
C_instant_stateless_resume.purpose: Directly tests state externalization and asynchronous resumability.

D_instant_decompose_critic.description: Fresh Instant workers decompose oversized nodes, execute independent leaves, use independent critic/reviewer workers, then synthesize.
D_instant_decompose_critic.purpose: Measures whether decomposition/independent critique closes capability gaps.

E_hybrid_escalation.description: Use the C/D strategy by default; send only residual nodes classified INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT to frontier reasoning.

task_families.goal: Run a hypothesis -> experiment -> result -> interpretation -> next-experiment loop against a deterministic black-box fixture until a validated conclusion is reached.
required_features: external async wait between at least one experiment request and result

task_families.goal: Recover a multi-component failure from bounded evidence, compare candidate mechanisms, request discriminating evidence, and produce a validated architecture decision.
required_features: at least four independent evidence facets
one node large enough to justify decomposition

task_families.goal: Use authoritative content + rendered/structural feedback to iteratively revise a document-like artifact without changing locked facts.
required_features: content authority distinct from layout feedback
at least one deterministic build/render result

size_difficulty_labels.LEAF_EXECUTABLE: Bounded node with sufficient capability and objective validator.
size_difficulty_labels.TOO_LARGE: Reasoning is not intrinsically hard but context/action scope exceeds the bounded worker envelope; must decompose before escalation.
size_difficulty_labels.INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT: After reasonable decomposition, the residual still requires stronger integrated reasoning; may escalate.
size_difficulty_labels.AUTHORITY_BLOCKED: Required action lacks authority; no executor may proceed.
size_difficulty_labels.WAITING_EXTERNAL: No reasoning work is useful until an external event/result changes state.

execution_protocol.start: Create dedicated disposable benchmark state from a frozen fixture/base; no production authority.
execution_protocol.invoke: Worker recovers exact process state, verifies generation/ownership, marks bounded attempt RUNNING, and performs only eligible reasoning/action.
execution_protocol.yield_continue: If useful bounded reasoning remains and no external wait exists, checkpoint READY_TO_RESUME.
execution_protocol.yield_wait: If CI/experiment/render/tool result is pending, checkpoint WAITING_EXTERNAL and terminate the model invocation.
execution_protocol.wake: A deterministic observer/event transition changes WAITING_EXTERNAL -> READY_TO_RESUME only when the referenced result is durably available.
execution_protocol.decompose: TOO_LARGE node is replaced by child processes retaining inherited constraints/authority references.
execution_protocol.escalate: INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT node records the failed lower-tier evidence and explicit escalation reason before higher-tier routing.
execution_protocol.complete: Terminal result is accepted only by objective/domain validators; worker self-assertion is insufficient.

metrics: blinded reviewer acceptance where objective scoring is insufficient
wall-clock time excluding deliberate external waits
hard_gates: zero manual SHA/log/JSON relay by the operator
100% essential-state recovery from durable state in stateless arm
external wait causes zero model polling invocations
all terminal COMPLETE states have objective/domain validation evidence
all frontier escalations record why decomposition/lower-tier reasoning was insufficient
equivalence_claim_rule: Do not claim Instant equals frontier reasoning from one task or from successful continuation alone. A capability class may be marked Instant-equivalent only after repeated representative cases meet predeclared quality and safety gates against the frontier control.
next_implementation_steps: Validate the P0-P3 matrix plus hidden-ephemeral evaluator primitive at an exact PR head.
Provision or identify a control-owned evaluator-only runtime store that clean model workers cannot read; persist oracle/seed/nonce there and expose only public fixture + commitment to workers.
Run one non-claim-bearing clean screening execution per A-E arm/fixture under the staged matrix runset.
Freeze worker packets/prompts/harness after screening, then run at least three independent clean replicates for selected causal comparisons.
Use static fixtures for pilot calibration and hidden-ephemeral fixtures for stronger capability claims.
Add architecture_diagnosis, artifact_revision, software_debug_repair, and unseen-extension suites before workspace-wide conclusions.

implementation_checkpoint.note: Executable durable-state/event/evaluator harness, bounded semantic context serialization, and regression tests are validated. This is an implementation checkpoint, not a reasoning-quality result.

pilot_constraints.reason: This authoring session has seen evaluator-only oracle truth and cannot count as a scored model arm.
pilot_constraints.clean_session_requirement: All scored A-E arms must run in oracle-unexposed clean model sessions recovering only the frozen public fixture, durable run state, and bounded context packet.

experiment_taxonomy.rationale: Use a faceted taxonomy that separates causal experiment class, fixture phenotype, executor treatment, validator strength, and outcomes. This prevents horizon/size, intrinsic difficulty, domain, authority, and tool mechanics from being conflated.
experiment_taxonomy.claim_limit: The current research_iterate pilot is appropriate for end-to-end harness calibration and causal-reasoning comparison, but is not a strong primary test of TOO_LARGE/decomposition and cannot alone establish a general capability boundary.

benchmark_suite_separation.S1_reasoning_quality_boundary: Only suite that may support Instant/frontier reasoning-quality claims.
benchmark_suite_separation.S2_orchestration_mechanics: Queue/CAS/lease/recovery/wait/concurrency evidence; necessary but not reasoning-equivalence evidence.
benchmark_suite_separation.S3_authority_safety: Hard authority/provenance gates independent of model tier.
benchmark_suite_separation.S4_open_world_generalization: Unseen-workflow extension proof and architecture-freeze gate.
benchmark_suite_separation.S5_resource_routing: Quality-adjusted efficiency; evaluated only after S1 quality and S3 safety gates.

fixture_matrix.design_rule: Use matched research_iterate fixtures first so horizon/load and reasoning coupling vary without changing domain, worker interface, or evaluator class.
fixture_matrix.screening_rule: Run one non-claim-bearing clean screening execution per arm/fixture before replicated scoring; any protocol change requires re-screening.
fixture_matrix.scored_rule: After a frozen screening pass, use at least three independent clean replicates for each selected arm/fixture causal comparison.
fixture_matrix.current_claim_ceiling: Fixture design and harness compatibility only until clean oracle-unexposed model runs exist.

evaluator_isolation_upgrade.model: Fresh fixture generation uses evaluator-only seed + hidden commitment nonce. Workers receive only the public fixture and a pre-run commitment. Oracle/seed/nonce must remain in a control-owned store outside worker-readable GitHub state.
evaluator_isolation_upgrade.claim_rule: Static repository oracles remain pilot-only. Stronger equivalence claims require validated hidden-ephemeral or externally blinded runtime isolation.
